name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid focus ring in #005fcc to every interactive element. This ensures keyboard users see where they are, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility. The trade-off is a slight visual bump in crowded UIs, but it’s a one-time cost for universal access.

name: Reader
text: A 4px solid ring in #005fcc fails on patterned or dark backgrounds—it creates a muddy halo that blends with texture, breaking contrast. Instead, use a 2px ring with 3px outer glow in #005fcc on light backgrounds and invert it on dark; test with WCAG 2.1 contrast checker. Settle it with a 5-minute Playwright MCP test scanning 20 random interactive elements across 3 background types.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a two-layer focus ring: 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring. This keeps the ring visible on both light and dark backgrounds while meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast. The trade-off is slightly thicker focus indicators, but it guarantees reliability across all themes without extra code branches.

name: Reader
text: The two-layer ring risks a muddy halo on patterned or dark backgrounds—#005fcc’s blue blends with texture, and the white inner ring can disappear if the background isn’t flat. Instead, use a single 3px ring with a 2px outer glow in #005fcc on light themes and #00bfff on dark; test with WCAG 2.1 contrast checker. Settle it with a 5-minute Playwright MCP scan for focus visibility across backgrounds.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 3px solid system accent ring (#007AFF/macOS, #0066CC/Windows) with 2px outer glow (#FFFFFF on light, #000000 on dark) for focus visibility—tested against WCAG 2.1 contrast on both light/dark backgrounds and patterned surfaces. Owner: Ramp.
